"""RoboPaint trajectory controller. All observations use the public robot client."""
import os,sys,json,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot
RUNDIR='/app/runs'
Q=[0.,1.,0.,0.]
SURFACE=.0202
SCALE=.227185/1024

def world(u,v,z):return [.0135925-(v+.5)*SCALE,.1135925-(u+.5)*SCALE,z]
class Painter:
 def __init__(self):
  self.r=Robot();self.obs=self.r.get_obs(cameras=[]);self.pose=np.array(self.obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14]);self.rows=[]
 def line(self,xyz,seconds):
  dest=np.array([*xyz,*Q]);n=max(1,int(np.ceil(seconds/.05)));self.rows.extend(np.linspace(self.pose,dest,n+1)[1:]);self.pose=dest
 def hold(self,seconds):self.line(self.pose[:3],seconds)
 def run(self,name,cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam'],video='none'):
  rows=np.array(self.rows);self.rows=[]
  for i in range(0,len(rows),200):
   a=rows[i:i+200];res=self.r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=.05,cameras=cameras,video=video,note=name)
   d=f'{RUNDIR}/{name}_{i//200:03}';res.save(d)
   for c,img in res.last.items():Image.fromarray(img).save(f'{d}/{c}.png')
   print(name,i,len(a),'tip',res.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),'time',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
  return res
if __name__=='__main__':
